reuse.why: All month-wide actions, including the new setLastMonthSpending, go through the existing isCategoryFilled, getAverageFillCategories and averageToBudgetAmount helpers.

duplication.why: The group-notes LEFT JOIN is pasted into three separate queries (getBudgetData, getAverageFillCategories, a new inline query in setZero), and the hidden rule is now decided twice inside isCategoryFilled (generic check plus the 'average' branch ternary).

placement.why: The template, #fixed and hidden exclusions sit in the shared isCategoryFilled in budget/actions.ts and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Adds an unused includeHiddenCategories parameter to resetIncomeCarryover, which is not a fill action, plus release-notes files.

maintainability.why: The selection rule is centralised, but isCategoryFilled is growing flag-dependent per-kind branches (dead 'copy' case, includeHidden ternary in default) and setZero rebuilds its own category query.

disguised_duplication.where: isCategoryFilled's default branch re-decides hidden/group_hidden through an includeHiddenCategories ternary after the new generic hidden check already did

abstraction_drift.where: isCategoryFilled and getAverageFillCategories gain includeHiddenCategories; the 'average' branch of isCategoryFilled gains a flag-specific ternary (group_hidden != null) while the 'copy' case collapses to a dead 'return true'
